prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity Android home-screen expense widget concept for the Chinese personal ledger app 花有谱.
Input Image 1 is ONLY a visual-brand reference of the existing app (mint/teal, pale cool gray, dark ink typography, soft corners). Do not reproduce its full app screen, donut chart, navigation, or transactions.
Create ONE standalone widget centered on a square 1200x1200 pale cool gray #F1F4F7 presentation background. Front-on flat UI, no perspective, no phone, no wallpaper art, no extra cards, no decorations, no title outside the widget.
Exact common geometry for the three sibling concepts: one 1000x960 px off-white #F8FAF7 rounded rectangle, x=100 y=120, radius=76 px, subtle natural shadow, thin almost invisible border. Internal padding 54px. The same-size widget must work for all periods.
Brand system: deep ink #20352C, secondary #52685C, accent teal #279E80, regular bars #87C7B1, faint guide lines #DBE7DF, selected pale mint #DFEEE4. Modern crisp Noto Sans SC Chinese typography and tabular sans numerals. Use generous spacing with a practical compact widget layout; large clear numeric total, consistent alignment, premium but implementable flat design.
Layout: top header has a small app name "花有谱" upper left, thin refresh outline icon upper right. Next row: period title at left with smaller date range immediately below, and prominent total on the right, small yuan symbol followed by bold amount. Header ends around y=330. Chart/calendar occupies x=154..1046 y=390..880. Under it a subtle horizontal divider at y=940. Bottom small centered 3-way segmented switch at x=420..780 y=970..1040, rounded pale-mint track, active pill teal with white text, inactive labels dark muted green. Exact switch labels "周" "月" "年". Show only this small switch in footer. Clear readable Chinese. No legends, no comparison badges, no financial advice, no watermark.
All example dates are based on 2026-11-06. Future dates without data use a light-gray em dash and no positive bar; past zero expenditure would be "0". Explicit numeric labels carry meaning, not color alone. This is a design rendering with illustrative data, not a screenshot of a live implementation.

PRIMARY REQUEST: WEEK VIEW showing expense on each of the seven days of the week, exactly seven vertical columns Monday through Sunday in chronological order. Title "本周花销". Date subtitle "11月2日 — 11月8日". Total "¥ 482.00". Active bottom segment "周".
Chart should use the entire reserved chart height, with three very faint horizontal guide lines, zero baseline near y=840 and chart day labels y=885. No vertical axis labels and no heavy borders. Seven moderately wide vertical bars with rounded tops, all on identical zero baseline, heights linearly proportional to [68,126,32,208,48,0,0]; Thursday is highest. Friday (today) is teal #279E80; other recorded days muted mint #87C7B1. Saturday/Sunday have NO bars, only faint tiny baseline markers. Direct value labels above each column in deep ink: "68", "126", "32", "208", "48", "—", "—". Baseline labels exactly "周一" "周二" "周三" "周四" "周五" "周六" "周日". Below "周五" put a tiny teal dot to identify today. All seven days and values must be legible with no overlap. Do not show any calendar grid.

PRIMARY REQUEST: MONTH VIEW with an accurate November 2026 calendar showing spending in every day cell, NOT a bar chart. Title "本月花销". Date subtitle "2026年11月". Total "¥ 578.00". Active bottom segment "月".
Calendar in the SAME content rectangle as week/year, with seven evenly spaced columns and SIX uniform-height week rows. Header labels exactly "一" "二" "三" "四" "五" "六" "日". Monday-first alignment is critical: November 1, 2026 is SUNDAY; November 30 is MONDAY. Accurate rows:
row 1: blank blank blank blank blank blank 1
row 2: 2 3 4 5 6 7 8
row 3: 9 10 11 12 13 14 15
row 4: 16 17 18 19 20 21 22
row 5: 23 24 25 26 27 28 29
row 6: 30 blank blank blank blank blank blank
Each actual date has a medium dark date number with smaller spending immediately underneath. Blank cells have neither date nor spend. Past/current values: Nov1 "96", Nov2 "68", Nov3 "126", Nov4 "32", Nov5 "208", Nov6 "48". All Nov7-Nov30 future expense lines are a light muted "—". Highlight TODAY Nov6 cell with a small rounded pale mint rectangle, date number teal and amount bold dark teal, and a tiny teal dot beside the date. All other cells remain almost white. Small, very subtle horizontal row separator lines, no heavy calendar borders. Make the dates and expense amounts visually distinct via size/weight. Six rows must be fully visible, readable and not overlap footer. No other month dates, no omitted dates, no extra rows, no bars.

PRIMARY REQUEST: YEAR VIEW with exactly TWELVE chronological vertical columns, one for each month, all fully visible in the SAME chart rectangle. Title "本年花销". Date subtitle "2026年". Total "¥ 35,178.00". Active bottom segment "年".
A clean twelve-column monthly spending bar chart, baseline y=840, three very faint horizontal guide lines, NO y-axis labels. Month labels directly below baseline: "1月" "2月" "3月" "4月" "5月" "6月" "7月" "8月" "9月" "10月" "11月" "12月". Equal spacing and narrow columns with rounded tops, numeric labels above each bar, carefully spaced. Values in yuan: [3290,2860,3640,3180,3520,4080,3360,3920,3470,3280,578,0]. Heights must be LINEARLY proportional to these amounts, so June is tallest and November is a very small bar. January-October use muted mint #87C7B1, November current month uses teal #279E80 and small teal dot below "11月", December future has NO positive bar, just faint baseline marker.
Direct labels above columns, clearly readable at the final image resolution, use exact compact values "3290", "2860", "3640", "3180", "3520", "4080", "3360", "3920", "3470", "3280", "578", "—". Avoid thousand separators in small bar labels to keep them readable, but keep comma in main total. All twelve values and month labels fit without overlap, truncation or omission. No calendar grid, no line chart, no extra analytics.
